storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 醒過來啊！

storyArray.name: chef
dialogue: 公主...真失禮，竟然在這裡睡著了。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 看你滿頭大汗的，沒問題嗎？

storyArray.name: chef
dialogue: 沒什麼大礙，只是發了一個被無頭牛索命的惡夢...
對了，還不趕快開工，就要被罵了...

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: chefcome

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 你兒子患的是什麼病？

storyArray.name: chef
dialogue: 我的兒子剛出生不久就患上了獸皮病...
如果我付不起醫藥費，醫生就不會再替我的小孩治病...
那麼，我的小孩就凶多吉少了。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: storyturn

storyArray.name: chef
dialogue: 原諒我吧，我也只是按照主人的意思去做。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: storyturn

storyArray.name: chef
dialogue: 咦，我的屠刀怎麼突然不見了？難道在外邊掉失了？

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: storydisappear

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 吽吽...吽吽...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 原來如此！
公主，它就是小乳牛的母親。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: checkcow

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 樂神，你怎麼知道母牛在說什麼？

storyArray.name: music
dialogue: 將神識定下來，然後用心感受就行。
這是每個生靈與生俱來的能力，可是多數人已把它遺忘了。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 吽吽...吽吽...

storyArray.name: music
dialogue: 竟然是你把屠刀藏了...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 樂神，牠把屠刀藏在哪裡？

storyArray.name: music
dialogue: 就藏在它的肚子裏。
母牛之所以吞刀，是因為它不忍看見自己的孩子被牢殺。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 你雖已投生蓄道，卻保留着人性。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: dragoncome

storyArray.name: dragon
dialogue: 小師妹，你還是一如往常的多愁善感。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playpoint

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 是師兄！

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 唉...我實在不忍看到這牛犢被牢殺...
小師妹，如果你不嫌棄，就讓我收養這對牛母子吧。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playpoint

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 師兄，有你照顧牠們，我就放心了。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 我也只是略盡綿力為小師妹分憂。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playerpoint

storyArray.name: scout
dialogue: 都督，一切準備妥當，可以馬上起行。

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playerpoint

storyArray.name: dragon
dialogue: 小師妹，我有要事在身，先行告退了。

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 雖說有點可惜，但既然師兄主意已決，我也不多作挽留了。

storyArray.name: dragon
dialogue: 感謝小師妹體諒...

storyArray.name: event
dialogue: playerpoint

storyArray.name: dragon
dialogue: 年輕人，我們走吧。

storyArray.name: music
dialogue: 公主，我聞到三毒石的氣息，就在你的師兄身上散發著...

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 看來我們找對了方向。

storyArray.name: music
dialogue: 那麼，公主有什麼好對策？

storyArray.name: player
dialogue: 不焦急，先把王都的三毒石拆掉吧。
